audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rated this HARD 8/10 with Swain winning all seven chart rows, while the packet levelChart, the content win[] column and a 56.47% win rate over 2072 games all put Katarina on every row.
audit.why: Swain is immobile and his entire trade pattern starts with Nevermove, an 850-range projectile that roots on the RETURN and is 12s at rank 1. A champion with two Shunpo charges invalidates it, which is exactly what the content layer already said.
audit.corrected: EVEN at 5/10 with Katarina on every row, both difficulty strings rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second' Demonic Ascension.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s at every rank. Nevermove is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s. Death's Hand is 7s at rank 1 and 3s at rank 5. Vision of Empire is 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in, including the 120s ult, which is the actual all-in clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interaction text said only 'his drain mode — disengage when it starts'. Two decisive mechanics were absent: Nevermove roots on the return pass, not the outgoing one, and it cancels Death Lotus.
audit.why: Riot's E text: the wave travels forward, THEN returns to Swain and roots what it hits, after which he can pull. So dodging backward in a straight line walks into the return. It carries hardCC and Death Lotus is a channel any CC cancels. His E cooldown also shortens during Demonic Ascension.
audit.corrected: Dodge laterally or Shunpo through him, and never start the channel with his E available.

audit.whatIsWrong: brief.missingInteractions key 23 says Swain 'bypasses stacking resistances (Ravenous Flock)' — that is not what his passive does.
audit.why: Riot's passive text is Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently raise his maximum health. That is a healing and HP-stacking passive, not resistance penetration. The actionable version is anti-heal timing, since his passive and Demonic Ascension are both healing.
audit.corrected: Written as anti-heal and Ignite timing rather than the false penetration claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: 3 lint findings (2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 digit-free cooldowns field), plus dontsFull[2].t referencing a spell shield Swain does not have.
audit.why: Deterministic lint output plus the kit.

notes: Third instance of the same defect shape (see also pantheon and ryze): the full layer was rated HARD 8/10 with Swain holding all seven phases[N].side rows, while the packet levelChart, the content win[] column and the 56.47% win rate over 2072 games all put Katarina on every row. Those three matchups suggest a systematic mis-seed on Katarina's full layer rather than three independent mistakes — worth a run-wide check of which katarina_mid entries have a diff/chart that disagrees with MC_REAL_GAMES. No win[N] edits were possible here; the content layer already read Katarina on all seven rows. Also: brief.missingInteractions key 23's first headline is WRONG — Ravenous Flock does not bypass resistances, it heals Swain and permanently raises his max health. I wrote the anti-heal advice that claim was reaching for instead. The second headline (Nevermove cancels Death Lotus) is correct and is now on the page, together with the detail that the root lands on the return pass. As on every Katarina brief, the 'grounding' flag on her Q is a tooltip-parse artefact and was not used.
